final: WITH matched AS (SELECT r.riskandmarginpivot, o.ordertune FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault), counts AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) as type_count FROM matched GROUP BY ordertune), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(type_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_val FROM counts) SELECT AVG(CAST(type_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_of_above_average, AVG(CAST(type_count AS FLOAT) - overall_avg.avg_val) as avg_excess FROM counts, overall_avg WHERE type_count > overall_avg.avg_val
